{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (a : ℂ) (v : V) :
  ‖a • v‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖v‖
name: LinearAlgebraGame.sca_mul
content:
The norm of a scalar multiple: `‖a • v‖= ‖a‖ * ‖v‖`.
This fundamental property shows how norms interact with scalar multiplication.
